name: Piccolo on-screen keyboard
author: Jorge Cohen
description: Touch/on-screen keyboard for the Omarchy shell (Hyprland). Glide (swipe) typing with a finger trail, a suggestion strip and terminal-aware autocorrect with per-language dictionaries fetched on demand; ANSI-staggered full boards and phone-style simplified boards for 12 language layouts (incl. AnySoftKeyboard imports), iOS-style globe switching with a manage panel, long-press accent/alternate popups, iPad-style split mode, key preview bubbles, real Ctrl/Alt/Super chords via ydotool, and a shared key surface for the lock screen.
